sections.title: Article 1: Basic Policy
items: The AiKano Operations Office (hereinafter referred to as “the Company”) recognizes the protection of users’ personal information as an important responsibility and complies with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information and other applicable laws and regulations.

sections.title: Article 2: Information We Collect
sections.preamble: We collect the following information to provide this service.

groups.heading: Information Provided Directly by Users
items: Email address (when registering)
Password (when registering; stored in hashed form)
Information users voluntarily enter during conversations (such as their name, address, or phone number)

groups.heading: Information Collected Automatically When Using the Service
items: IP address and access logs
Device and browser information
Usage history on this service (such as login dates and times, billing history, and characters used)
Chat content between users and AI characters

sections.title: Article 3: Purposes for Using Information
sections.preamble: We use the information we collect only for the following purposes:
items: Providing, operating, and improving the Service
User authentication and account management
Billing and point management
Improving the quality of AI responses and training and improving our AI models
Detecting and addressing unauthorized use and violations of the Terms
Responding to legal requirements (including inquiries from law enforcement agencies)
Responding to inquiries

sections.title: Article 4: Handling of Chat Content (Important)
sections.preamble: Given the nature of this service, chat content is handled as follows.

items.label: Staff review:
items.text: Our staff may review chats between users and characters to maintain and improve response quality, detect misuse, and improve the training of our AI models.

items.label: Use for AI training:
items.text: Chat content may be processed to remove personally identifiable information and used as training data for our AI models.

items.label: No sharing with third parties:
items.text: We will not provide or sell chat content to third parties, such as advertisers or other companies, except as required by law.

items.label: Legal compliance:
items.text: If illegal activity, such as requests involving child sexual abuse material or the encouragement of criminal activity, is detected, we may preserve the relevant chat logs as evidence and provide them to law enforcement authorities as necessary.

sections.note: By registering for this service, users agree to the handling of chat content described above.

sections.title: Article 5: Provision to Third Parties
sections.preamble: We will not provide the personal information we collect to third parties except in the following cases:
items: When the user has given prior consent
When required by applicable laws and regulations (such as inquiries from courts or investigative authorities)
When necessary to protect a person's life, physical safety, or property
When providing information to contractors necessary for operating the Service (only if a confidentiality agreement has been signed)

sections.title: Article 6: Use of External Services
sections.preamble: This service uses the following external services, each of which may be subject to its own privacy policy.

items.label: Payment services:
items.text: Payment processing when purchasing points (we do not store credit card information on our servers)

items.label: Analytics tools:
items.text: Usage analytics to improve the service (such as Google Analytics)

items.label: AI foundation models:
items.text: We may use external AI APIs (such as OpenAI and Anthropic) to generate responses. In such cases, conversation content may be sent to the API of the relevant service.

sections.title: Article 7: Use of Cookies
items: This service uses cookies to maintain your login status and improve the service. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may become unavailable.

sections.title: Article 8: Storage and Management of Personal Information
items: We will implement appropriate security measures to prevent the leakage, loss, or damage of personal information.
We will retain personal information for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which it is used, and securely dispose of it when it is no longer needed.
Even after you close your account, we may retain certain information for a specified period if required by law or necessary to prevent unauthorized use.

sections.title: Article 9: Personal Information of Minors
items: This service is intended for users aged 18 and older, excluding high school students. If we discover that a user is under 18, we will delete their account and data.

sections.title: Article 10: Requests for Disclosure, Correction, and Deletion
items: Users may request disclosure, correction, deletion, or suspension of the use of their personal information held by us. To submit a request, please contact our inquiry desk at info@aikano.chat. After verifying your identity, we will respond in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

sections.title: Article 11: Changes to the Privacy Policy
items: We may change this Privacy Policy as necessary. If we make any material changes, we will notify you through the Service. The revised Policy will take effect when it is posted.

sections.title: Article 12: Contact Us
sections.preamble: For inquiries about how we handle personal information, please contact us at:
